verdict.rationale: Mailchimp has documented webhook subscription support in both Marketing API (subscription/campaign events) and Transactional API (message events like send, bounce, open, click, spam), with docs describing setup via a POST-accepting URL. Caveat: webhooks require Standard/Premium plan, gating this capability behind pricing tiers, and there's no evidence of AI-native tooling (e.g., structured event schemas for agents, MCP-style integration) beyond generic webhook docs. missing for 10: no evidence of AI-agent-specific webhook consumption patterns, no independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability, plan-based gating limits universal applicability.
